Round 2 of INSPIRE results

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(magrittr)
library(rsample)

```



## Constants
```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64
```

```{r}
sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

zmb.results.inspire <- zmb.results.inspire %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  )
```

## HIV metrics

### All ages
```{r}
zmb.results.inspire %>% 
  filter(Year > 2015) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor), 
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Infected = mean(Infected), 
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Died_from_HIV, Infected, Newly.Infected, On_ART),
               values_to = "Value", 
               names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name ) ) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(Metric), scales = "free_y")
```

# Calculate Metrics
Aggregate metrics over 10 years
```{r}
## All ages
metrics.all.ages <- cbind(
  zmb.results.inspire %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2035.5) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup(),
  zmb.results.inspire %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2035.5) %>% 
    filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV.baseline = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected.baseline = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected.baseline = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART.baseline = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART.baseline = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-scenario_name)
)  %>% mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.change = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.change = Infected - Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.change = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.change = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.change = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.change/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.pct = Infected.change/Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.change/Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.pct = On_ART.change/On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.change/Off_ART.baseline
  )
```

## Now with 100% more error bars

```{r}
aggregate.data.differences <- function(data, scenario.name, start_year, end_year, age_min, age_max,
                                       comparison_scenario = "baseline"){
  
  data.agg <- data %>% 
    mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>%
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    filter(Year >= start_year, 
           Year < end_year,
           Age >= age_min,
           Age < age_max)  %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor), 
              Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART*pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART*pop_scaling_factor/2),
              .groups = 'keep') %>%
    ungroup()
  
  data.agg.2 <- data.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == comparison_scenario) %>% 
    select(sim.ix, 
         Newly.Infected.Base = Newly.Infected,
         Died_from_HIV.Base = Died_from_HIV,
         On_ART.Base = On_ART,
         Off_ART.Base = Off_ART
         ) %>% 
    merge(data.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name),
          by = c("sim.ix")) %>%
    mutate(
      Newly.Infected.diff = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.Base,
      Newly.Infected.pct = (Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.Base)/Newly.Infected.Base,
      Died_from_HIV.diff = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.Base,
      Died_from_HIV.pct = (Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.Base)/Died_from_HIV.Base,
      On_ART.diff = On_ART - On_ART.Base,
      On_ART.pct = (On_ART - On_ART.Base)/On_ART.Base,
      Off_ART.diff = Off_ART - Off_ART.Base,
      Off_ART.pct = (Off_ART - Off_ART.Base)/Off_ART.Base,
      
    ) 
  
  data.agg.diffs <- data.agg.2 %>%
    group_by(scenario_name) %>%
    summarize(
      Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
      Newly.Infected.diff.sd = sd(Newly.Infected.diff),
      Newly.Infected.diff = mean(Newly.Infected.diff),
      Newly.Infected.pct.sd = sd(Newly.Infected.pct),
      Newly.Infected.pct = mean(Newly.Infected.pct),
      Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
      Died_from_HIV.diff.sd = sd(Died_from_HIV.diff),
      Died_from_HIV.diff = mean(Died_from_HIV.diff),
      Died_from_HIV.pct.sd = sd(Died_from_HIV.pct),
      Died_from_HIV.pct = mean(Died_from_HIV.pct),
      On_ART = mean(On_ART),
      On_ART.diff.sd = sd(On_ART.diff),
      On_ART.diff = mean(On_ART.diff),
      On_ART.pct.sd = sd(On_ART.pct),
      On_ART.pct = mean(On_ART.pct),
      Off_ART = mean(Off_ART), 
      Off_ART.diff.sd = sd(Off_ART.diff),
      Off_ART.diff = mean(Off_ART.diff),
      Off_ART.pct.sd = sd(Off_ART.pct),
      Off_ART.pct = mean(Off_ART.pct),
      .groups = 'keep'
      )

  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data.agg.2, times = 500)
  bt_resamples$mean.infected <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected")
  bt_resamples$mean.infected.diff <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.infected.pct <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths.diff <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths.pct <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.diff <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.pct <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.diff <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.pct <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART.pct")
  
  infected_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected, probs = c(0.25, 0.975))
  infected.diff_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected.diff, probs = c(.025, .975))
  infected.pct_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected.pct, probs = c(.025, .975))
  deaths_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths, probs = c(0.25, 0.975))
  deaths.diff_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths.diff, probs = c(.025, .975))
  deaths.pct_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths.pct, probs = c(.025, .975))
  onart_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART, probs = c(0.25, 0.975))
  onart.diff_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.diff, probs = c(.025, .975))
  onart.pct_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.pct, probs = c(.025, .975))
  offart_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART, probs = c(0.25, 0.975))
  offart.diff_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.diff, probs = c(.025, .975))
  offart.pct_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.pct, probs = c(.025, .975))
  
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected_95LL <- infected_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected_95UL <- infected_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.diff_95LL <- infected.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.diff_95UL <- infected.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.pct_95LL <- infected.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.pct_95UL <- infected.pct_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV_95LL <- deaths_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV_95UL <- deaths_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.diff_95LL <- deaths.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.diff_95UL <- deaths.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.pct_95LL <- deaths.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.pct_95UL <- deaths.pct_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART_95LL <- onart_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART_95UL <- onart_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.diff_95LL <- onart.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.diff_95UL <- onart.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.pct_95LL <- onart.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.pct_95UL <- onart.pct_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART_95LL <- offart_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART_95UL <- offart_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.diff_95LL <- offart.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.diff_95UL <- offart.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.pct_95LL <- offart.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.pct_95UL <- offart.pct_95[[2]]

  data.agg.diffs <- data.agg.diffs %>% select(
        "scenario_name",
        "Newly.Infected", "Newly.Infected_95LL", "Newly.Infected_95UL",
        "Newly.Infected.diff", "Newly.Infected.diff_95LL", "Newly.Infected.diff_95UL",
        "Newly.Infected.pct", "Newly.Infected.pct_95LL","Newly.Infected.pct_95UL",
        "Died_from_HIV", "Died_from_HIV_95LL", "Died_from_HIV_95UL",
        "Died_from_HIV.diff", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95UL",
        "Died_from_HIV.pct", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95UL",
        "On_ART", "On_ART_95LL", "On_ART_95UL",
        "On_ART.diff", "On_ART.diff_95LL", "On_ART.diff_95UL",
        "On_ART.pct", "On_ART.pct_95LL", "On_ART.pct_95UL",
        "Off_ART", "Off_ART_95LL", "Off_ART_95UL",
        "Off_ART.diff", "Off_ART.diff_95LL", "Off_ART.diff_95UL",
        "Off_ART.pct", "Off_ART.pct_95LL", "Off_ART.pct_95UL" )

  data.agg.diffs
  
}

 bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}
```

# Plots

First set of plots are for comparing the Baseline against all assumptions

Second set of plots are for comparing Baseline against both reengagement scenarios

```{r}
adults.plot.dat <- zmb.results.inspire %>%
  filter(Age >= 15) %>%
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "all", "reengage.A", "reengage.B")) %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
            On_ART = mean(On_ART),
            Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
            )

adults.plot.dat$scenario <- factor(adults.plot.dat$scenario_name, levels = c( "all", "reengage.A", "reengage.B","baseline"))


youth.plot.dat <- zmb.results.inspire %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age <25) %>%
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "all", "reengage.A", "reengage.B")) %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
            On_ART = mean(On_ART),
            Off_ART = mean(Off_ART),
            Infected = mean(Infected)
            )


youth.plot.dat$scenario <- factor(youth.plot.dat$scenario_name, levels = c( "all", "reengage.A", "reengage.B","baseline"))

```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous("HIV Acquisitions", breaks = seq(0,40000,10000), limits = c(0,45000),
                     labels = c(0, "10,000", "20,000", "30,000", "40,000")
                     ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        #axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        #plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        text = element_text(family = "sans"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title= element_text(size = 16))

hiv.acquisitions.adults.reengagement

ggsave(filename = "INSPIRE_ZMB_HIV_acquisitions_adults_reengagment.pdf",  plot = hiv.acquisitions.adults.reengagement, 
       width = 5, height = 4, units = 'in')
```

# Abstract

## Base population

```{r}
zmb.results.inspire %>% 
  filter(Year == 2025, 
           Age >= 15, Age < 25) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)
            ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(Population = mean(Population),
            Infected = mean(Infected))
```


## Results

```{r}
youth.abstract.table <- rbind(
  aggregate.data.differences(zmb.results.inspire, "baseline", 2025, 2035, 15, 25,
                             comparison_scenario = "baseline"),
  aggregate.data.differences(zmb.results.inspire, "all", 2025, 2035, 15, 25,
                             comparison_scenario = "baseline"),
  aggregate.data.differences(zmb.results.inspire, "reengage.A", 2025, 2035, 15, 25,
                             comparison_scenario = "baseline"),
  aggregate.data.differences(zmb.results.inspire, "reengage.B", 2025, 2035, 15, 25,
                             comparison_scenario = "baseline")
)

youth.abstract.table %>% filter(scenario_name %in% c("all", "baseline")) %>% 
  select(
    "scenario_name",
    "Newly.Infected", "Newly.Infected_95LL", "Newly.Infected_95UL",
    "Died_from_HIV", "Died_from_HIV_95LL", "Died_from_HIV_95UL",
    "On_ART", "On_ART_95LL", "On_ART_95UL",
    "Off_ART", "Off_ART_95LL", "Off_ART_95UL"
  )

youth.abstract.table %>% #filter(scenario_name %in% c("all", "baseline")) %>% 
  select(
    "scenario_name",
    "Newly.Infected.pct", "Newly.Infected.pct_95LL", "Newly.Infected.pct_95UL",
    "Died_from_HIV.pct", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95UL",
    "On_ART.pct", "On_ART.pct_95LL", "On_ART.pct_95UL",
    "Off_ART.pct", "Off_ART.pct_95LL", "Off_ART.pct_95UL"
  ) 


youth.abstract.table %>% 
  select(
    "scenario_name",
    "Newly.Infected.diff", "Newly.Infected.diff_95LL", "Newly.Infected.diff_95UL",
    "Died_from_HIV.diff", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95UL",
    "On_ART.diff", "On_ART.diff_95LL", "On_ART.diff_95UL",
    "Off_ART.diff", "Off_ART.diff_95LL", "Off_ART.diff_95UL"
  ) 
```
